summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The challenge is remembering that growth requires honesty as well as positivity. It is easy to focus on the good and overlook what needs attention. You may avoid difficult conversations, assume things will work themselves out, or mistake comfort for progress.
advice: Enjoy what is good, but do not ignore what needs attention. This connection works best when appreciation and responsibility are both present.
